description_en: Updates custom image information in a media set by calling the UpdateImage operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateImage接口更新媒体集中用户自定义的图片信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-image --project immimagetest --set-id ser001 --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateImage

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS Uri。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en: The remarks information. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
parameters.help_zh: 标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息
parameters.name: remarks_a

parameters.help_en: The remarks information. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
parameters.help_zh: 标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息
parameters.name: remarks_b

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source data. Valid values:

image: The source data type is image.
video: The source data type is video
parameters.help_zh:
源数据的类型，包括如下选项：

image：源数据类型为图片。
video：源数据类型为视频
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS Uri。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: source_uri

parameters.help_en: The storage location of the image
parameters.name: source_position

parameters.help_en: The remarks information. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
parameters.help_zh: 标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息
parameters.name: remarks_c

parameters.help_en: The remarks information. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
parameters.help_zh: 标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息
parameters.name: remarks_d

parameters.help_en: The external ID, which is used to bind with the ID in your application layer, if applicable
parameters.help_zh: 外部ID，用于和您的应用层的ID（如果有）进行绑定
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en: The list of face recognition results
parameters.name: faces

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the image was added to the media set
CreateTime.description_zh: 图片加入媒体集的时间

RemarksA.description_en:
The remarks information.

If this parameter is not specified when updating the image, the returned value is the remarks information that was set when the image was added to the media set
RemarksA.description_zh:
标记信息。

如果更新图片时未设置此参数，则返回值为图片加入媒体集时设置的标记信息
